_comment: Shared contract fixture for Story s3: the repoFields of the config.catalog payload plus one repo.settings.get payload. The terminal, VS Code and JetBrains clients must render the same rows from it. src/cli/__tests__/repo-fields-contract.test.ts checks repoFields equals the daemon table; regenerate with the snippet in that test if the table changes.

repoFields.label: Tracker
repoFields.description: Which tracker this repo uses; none turns tracker integration off.

repoFields.label: Owner
repoFields.description: GitHub owner. Empty means the origin remote.

repoFields.label: Repository
repoFields.description: GitHub repository name. Empty means the origin remote.

repoFields.label: GitHub host
repoFields.description: The host gh signs in to.

repoFields.label: Branch pattern
repoFields.description: Branch name pattern with {id}, {slug} and {type}; a parked draft goes to this branch. {id} is required.

repoFields.label: Sign-in
repoFields.description: Who gh is signed in as, read live.

repoFields.label: Resolved target
repoFields.description: The owner and repository the tracker calls go to, and where that came from.

repoFields.label: Team mode
repoFields.description: Whether this repo runs in team mode.

repoFields.label: Signoff stages
repoFields.description: Stages that need a signoff before the next stage starts.

repoFields.label: Claims enforced
repoFields.description: Whether only the assignee may change a stage unit.

repoFields.label: Administrators
repoFields.description: People who may override a claim.

repoFields.label: Task issues forced
repoFields.description: Whether a tracker issue is created for every Task.
